Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your order #4498, and please accept our sincere apologies for the delay in delivery. We completely understand how frustrating it can be when an order does not arrive on the date that was promised, especially when you have been waiting for it since Monday. Delays like this can sometimes happen because of high order volumes, weather conditions, local holidays, or issues at our courier partner's sorting hub, and we are truly sorry that it has affected you. We have escalated your order to our logistics team, who will contact the courier partner and find out the exact status of your parcel. You should receive an update with the new expected delivery date within the next 24 to 48 hours. In the meantime, you can also track your parcel using the link in your order confirmation email. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Regards,
Customer Care
